metadata.title: Enhanced Preview with Multi-Track Compositing
metadata.architectureNote: VideoCompositor infrastructure already implements multi-track rendering at 60fps. This story extends it with PiP positioning and audio mixing only.

story.iWant: to see my multi-track timeline rendered correctly in preview
story.soThat: I can verify my picture-in-picture and overlay effects
story.tasks: - Task 1: Extend CompositorClip interface to support PiP metadata - Task 2: Implement PiP rendering in VideoCompositor (calculatePipDimensions, calculatePipPosition, update renderFrame) - Task 3: Add visual border for PiP overlays (2px white border) - Task 4: Implement Web Audio API for audio mixing (AudioMixer utility class) - Task 5: Add multi-track visual feedback to PreviewPlayer (badge) - Task 6: Edge case handling for PiP and Audio (26 specific cases) - Task 7: Testing and validation (all ACs + edge cases) - Task 8: Performance optimization validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Preview player renders Track 2 clips overlaid on Track 1 clips 2. Webcam/PiP clips display in appropriate corner with correct size 3. Real-time playback shows composited multi-track result 4. Audio from both tracks mixed appropriately (Track 1 primary 100%, Track 2 secondary 80%) 5. Scrubbing updates preview with correct multi-track composition 6. Preview maintains 30fps smooth playback with 2 tracks (compositor achieves 60fps)

docs.doc: Track 1 gain = 1.0 (100%), Track 2 gain = 0.8 (80%) per tech spec line 709. Use Web Audio API GainNode for per-track volume control. Handle edge cases: AudioContext blocked, suspended, no audio tracks.

pipSize as percentage (e.g., 0.25 = 25% of canvas width), clamp to [0.05, 0.5]. pipPosition: 'top-left' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-right'. Default: 'bottom-right', size 25%. Support multiple aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 21:9.

code.artifact:
VideoCompositor class manages canvas-based multi-track rendering. ALREADY IMPLEMENTS: - 60fps rendering with requestAnimationFrame - Video element pool with LRU caching (max 10 elements) - Automatic clip transitions via updateActiveClips() - Frame-accurate seeking - Performance monitoring - Video loading error handling with sourceerror events
THIS STORY EXTENDS: - renderFrame(): Add PiP logic for trackIndex > 0 - Add calculatePipDimensions() helper - Add calculatePipPosition() helper - Integrate AudioMixer for audio gain control

code.artifact:
Create AudioMixer class with methods: - initializeContext(): Lazy AudioContext creation - connectVideo(video, trackIndex): Connect video to audio graph with gain - disconnectVideo(video): Disconnect video from audio graph - setGain(video, gain): Update gain for video - resumeContext(): Handle suspended AudioContext - dispose(): Cleanup
Edge case handling: - AudioContext blocked: Defer initialization, catch errors - AudioContext suspended: Expose resumeContext() for user interaction - Video already connected: Disconnect first - No audio streams: Skip AudioContext creation

story-context.constraints: - VideoCompositor already handles multi-track rendering at 60fps (exceeds 30fps requirement) - PiP positioning: 20px padding from canvas edges - PiP size validation: clamp to [0.05, 0.5] range (5% min, 50% max) - PiP default: position = 'bottom-right', size = 0.25 (25%) - Audio mixing: Track 1 = 100%, Track 2 = 80% (Web Audio API) - Border: 2px white around Track 2 overlay - Performance target: 16ms per frame (60fps) - already achieved by compositor - Track 1 (trackIndex 0) renders full-screen with aspect-fit - Track 2+ (trackIndex > 0) renders as PiP overlay - Canvas context optimization: {alpha: false, desynchronized: true} - already implemented - Aspect ratio support: 16:9 (landscape), 9:16 (portrait), 1:1 (square), 21:9 (ultra-wide)

tests.standards: Manual integration testing for PiP positioning (all 4 corners), audio mixing (listen test for 80% Track 2), visual feedback (border, badge). Performance profiling with Chrome DevTools: verify 60fps (16ms per frame), CPU usage < 70%.
tests.locations: Manual testing: Load multi-track timeline, test playback, scrubbing, all PiP positions, audio mixing, edge cases. Performance: Chrome DevTools Performance tab, monitor frame render time, CPU usage, memory leaks.
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify Track 2 renders overlaid on Track 1 (compositor handles layering by trackIndex) - AC2: Manual test all 4 PiP corners + portrait/square/ultra-wide videos, verify 20px padding and border - AC3: Manual test playback synchronization (compositor already syncs via updateActiveClips) - AC4: Manual verify audio mixing at Track 1=100%, Track 2=80% with Web Audio API GainNode - AC5: Manual test scrubbing updates PiP correctly (compositor handles seek) - AC6: Performance test verify 60fps (16ms per frame) with PiP rendering - Edge: Invalid pipSize (0, negative, >1.0) → defaults to 0.25 - Edge: Portrait video → calculate height-first, then width - Edge: AudioContext blocked → catch error, continue with muted playback - Edge: Track 1 empty + Track 2 full → show error message - Edge: Both tracks no audio → skip AudioContext creation

pipEdgeCases.case: Invalid pipSize (0, negative, >1.0): Clamp to [0.05, 0.5], default 0.25
Invalid pipPosition (typo, wrong value): Default to 'bottom-right'
Portrait video (9:16): Calculate height-first, then width
Square video (1:1): Use pipSize for both dimensions
Ultra-wide video (21:9+): Maintain aspect ratio, clamp to max dimensions
Video dimensions not ready (videoWidth = 0): Skip PiP rendering this frame
PiP exceeds canvas bounds: Clamp position to keep within canvas
Very small canvas (< 200px): Set min PiP size to 80px
Very large canvas (> 4096px): Log warning, continue

audioEdgeCases.case: AudioContext blocked by browser: Catch error, log, continue with muted playback
AudioContext suspended: Provide resumeContext() method, call on user interaction
Video already connected to graph: Disconnect first, then reconnect
Track 1 no audio, Track 2 has audio: Set Track 2 gain to 1.0 (promote to primary)
Both tracks no audio: Don't create AudioContext (wasteful)
Gain values outside [0, 1]: Clamp to valid range
Web Audio API not supported: Fallback to video.volume property

trackConfigEdgeCases.case: Single track (Track 1 only): Skip PiP logic entirely, render full-screen
Empty Track 2: Render Track 1 only, no compositing overhead
Track 1 empty, Track 2 has clips: Show error overlay "Track 1 required"
Both tracks empty: Show placeholder (already handled by PreviewPlayer)
Track duration mismatch: VideoCompositor already handles (longer track continues)
Same source file on both tracks: VideoCompositor pool allows duplicate elements

edgeCases.summary: Total: 26 edge cases identified Critical (must handle): 5 cases - Invalid pipSize, invalid pipPosition, video not ready, AudioContext blocked, video already connected, Track 1 empty High (likely to occur): 8 cases - Aspect ratios, canvas bounds, AudioContext suspended, track audio configurations Medium (possible): 3 cases - Ultra-wide video, small canvas, gain validation Low (rare): 10 cases - Large canvas, Web Audio fallback, empty tracks, duration mismatch, same source

architectureContext.existingInfrastructure: VideoCompositor system ALREADY PROVIDES: - ✅ Multi-track canvas rendering at 60fps (exceeds 30fps requirement) - ✅ Video element pool with LRU caching (max 10 elements) - ✅ Automatic clip transitions via updateActiveClips() - ✅ Frame-accurate seeking with single-frame rendering - ✅ Performance monitoring with frame time tracking - ✅ Event system for timeupdate, play, pause, ended, clipchange - ✅ Video loading error handling with sourceerror events - ✅ Memory management and resource cleanup - ✅ PlaybackOrchestrator adapter for timeline-to-compositor conversion - ✅ PlaybackStore integration via callbacks - ✅ PreviewPlayer canvas-based rendering
architectureContext.workRequired:
This story EXTENDS VideoCompositor with: 1. PiP positioning logic for Track 2+ overlays (modify renderFrame(), add helpers) 2. Web Audio API for per-track gain control (new AudioMixer utility) 3. PiP metadata on clips (extend CompositorClip interface) 4. Visual feedback (2px white border, multi-track badge) 5. Edge case handling for PiP and audio (26 cases)
DO NOT rebuild existing infrastructure. Only add PiP positioning and audio mixing.
Estimated implementation: ~150 lines of new code (vs 500+ if built from scratch)
architectureContext.keyFiles: - src/renderer/src/utils/VideoCompositor.ts (modify renderFrame(), add calculatePipDimensions/Position) - src/renderer/src/types/compositor.types.ts (extend CompositorClip interface) - src/renderer/src/utils/playbackOrchestrator.ts (pass through PiP metadata) - src/renderer/src/utils/AudioMixer.ts (NEW - ~100 lines) - src/renderer/src/components/Preview/PreviewPlayer.tsx (add multi-track badge - ~20 lines) - src/renderer/src/components/Timeline/timeline.types.ts (extend Clip interface - ~2 lines)
